content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List the project documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any relevant detector-upgrade/environmental-policy notes to extract the three allowed gas mixtures, their composition identifiers, GWP100 values, and any documented guidance on acceptable RPC gas gaps."},{"id":"s2","description":"Filter the three candidate mixtures against the hard GWP100 requirement, keeping only mixtures with GWP100 <= 150; record the numeric GWP100 values and candidate indices for traceability."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each GWP-compliant candidate mixture, run simulate_time_resolution at representative gaps spanning the allowed 1–3 mm range, including 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm, and record all numeric time-resolution results."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the mixture-gap combinations with simulated time resolution <= 1.5 ns; if the best point is not clearly at one of the sampled gaps, run additional simulations near the best sampled gap within 1–3 mm to refine the optimum."},{"id":"s5","description":"Select the single compliant combination with the lowest simulated time resolution, verifying that its mixture is one of the three allowed candidates, GWP100 <= 150, gas gap is between 1 and 3 mm, and time resolution <= 1.5 ns; record the final numeric gap, GWP100, and time resolution for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Mixture-G3","gap_mm":2,"justification":"Mixture-G3 at a 2.0 mm gas gap gives the best simulated time resolution among all sampled candidate/gap combinations: 0.876 ns, comfortably better than the 1.5 ns hard requirement. The 2.0 mm gap is within the allowed 1–3 mm range and matches the documented baseline gap. However, the recorded project results contain no documented GWP100 values for any candidate mixture, and the GWP filter kept zero candidates; therefore this is only a performance-based/conditional recommendation, not a fully verified compliant choice under the GWP100 hard requirement.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Recommended option is Mixture-G3, recorded as candidate index 3 among the three candidates."},{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible time resolution.","status":"met","evidence":"Best simulated result ignoring GWP is Mixture-G3 at 2.0 mm with time resolution 0.876 ns; other recorded 2.0 mm values are G1 = 1.323 ns and G2 = 2.042 ns."},{"requirement":"Time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.","status":"met","evidence":"Mixture-G3 at 2.0 mm has simulated time resolution 0.876 ns, which is better than 1.5 ns."},{"requirement":"GWP100 of the mixture must not exceed 150.","status":"unknown","evidence":"Recorded GWP100 values for Mixture-G1, G2, and G3 are all -1/undocumented, with gwp100_value_documented_* = 0 and passes_gwp_requirement_* = 0; no GWP-compliant candidate was verified."},{"requirement":"Gas gap between 1 and 3 mm.","status":"met","evidence":"Recommended gap is 2.0 mm, within the allowed 1–3 mm range."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted Mixture-G3 with a 2.0 mm gas gap."}]}
